newsitem.title: FRANCE: Netanyahu,Chirac to meet in Paris on September 25.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu,Chirac to meet in Paris on September 25.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is to meet French President Jacques Chirac in Paris next Wednesday, their first talks since Netanyahu's election in May, Chirac's office said on Friday.
The two men are to lunch at the Elysee Palace. Their talks are likely to focus on faltering Middle East peace efforts.
In recent months, Chirac has sought to strengthen French ties with Arab nations while insisting this would not jeopardise relations with Israel.
Chirac is due to meet Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri in Paris on September 28.
